based_on: The property at 1337 Queen Street West is located on the south side of Queen Street West between Dunn Avenue and Cowan Avenue.
This property is known as the West Block of the Parkdale Hub project and currently has a one-storey building on it.
The proposal is to tear down the existing building and build a 16-storey mixed-use tower with a 4-storey podium.
The new building will stay owned by the City and will include purpose-built affordable housing.
The demolition and new building are proposed to create new affordable rental housing, better community facilities, and updated public spaces.
City Council previously approved a heritage permit for this project on June 24 and 25, 2026.
The updated proposal raises the height of the 4-storey podium by 1.2m to allow for taller ceilings in the ground floor community space.
A separate minor variance application is also needed for the proposed changes.
